Distribution. USA: Arizona (Burks 1979). Molecular taxonomy. Alternating generations were matched using DNA data, with four individuals (two asexual females, two sexual males) sequenced for both cytb and ITS 2. Two cytb haplotypes were found across the four individuals, differing by 0.92 % (GenBank accessions OM 321623 – OM 321626); two ITS 2 alleles were also observed, differing by 0.19 % (with a single base indel within a polyT repeat region; OM 331816 – OM 331819).
